findings.body: The doc comment says `Shorten \`text\` to at most \`limit\` characters`, but when `head.rfind(' ')` returns `None`, the code returns `format!("{head}…")` where `head` has exactly `limit` characters, so the total is `limit+1` characters. This violates the documented bound. For example, `shorten("AimlesslyLongWordWithoutSpaces", 20)` would return a 21-character string. Fix by taking `limit-1` characters in that branch before appending the ellipsis.
findings.title: Ensure returned length never exceeds `limit` characters

value.summary: `shorten` violates its documented bound when no space is found within the first `limit` characters, producing `limit+1` characters.
